## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run format:check`
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `bun run verify:built` (if a dependency or an import changed)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Documentation updated (user-visible change) and `[Unreleased]` entry added to CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] Commit messages are in English
